import parse

# Test left-aligned search

print('Left-align search:', r.fixed if r else None)

# Test center-aligned search  
r2 = parse.search('{:^}', 'hello     world')
print('Center-align search:', r2.fixed if r2 else None)

# Test right-aligned search
r3 = parse.search('{:>}', 'hello       world')
print('Right-align search:', r3.fixed if r3 else None)
"
